title: A permanent public identifier for concepts and published Stories
description:
As a machine reader or linker, I want every public Concept and published Story to have an identifier that never changes, so that links and structured data survive renames and slug changes. Part of the Vault-LD pilot; Shipped first. Identifier built from the lineage id; the id address forwards to the current page (Ryan decision 2).

```gherkin
Feature: Permanent public identifiers
  Scenario: A Story keeps its identifier when its slug changes
    Given a published Story with a public identifier
    When an editor changes the Story's slug and publishes again
    Then the page's structured data carries the same identifier as before
    And the identifier's address forwards to the Story's new page

  Scenario: A renamed concept keeps its identifier
    Given an accepted concept with a wiki page
    When the concept is renamed
    Then its identifier is unchanged

  Scenario: A thing that is not public has no identifier address
    Given a draft Story and a concept nobody accepted
    Then neither has a public identifier address
```
